global_rules: No generic Inter or Space Grotesk. Typography must be distinct and narrative-driven.
Bold cohesive art direction: Deep black canvas, neon cyan/blue accents, grid/particle tech backgrounds.
No personal photo. Use abstract data, code, or neon geometry as deliberate product photography.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

headings.description: Used for hero, section titles, and large numbers. Bold, wide, futuristic, and tech-driven.

body.description: Used for all body text, stats, labels, and code-like elements to emphasize the CS/Data/AI professional background.

rules: Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Use #00F0FF (Neon Cyan) strictly for highlights, glowing borders, CTAs, and key data points (metrics).
Never use pure #000000 without noise/texture. The background should be #050505.
Apply text-shadows on Cyan text over dark backgrounds to emulate a neon glow (e.g., drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)]).

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Asymmetry, Visual Tension, and High-Density grids where data lives.
layout_and_spacing.grids: Use 'Bento' Grid for Skills and Projects. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12. Generous gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
rules: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-8).
Never center-align paragraphs. Use diagonals, structured left-alignment, and negative space to guide the eye.

components.hero: Kinetic Hero. Left-aligned massive 'Unbounded' typography. On-load masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion. Subtle background grid or 3D particles.
components.about: Numbered manifesto chapters. Use a stark, editorial layout. Large numbers (01, 02) in Cyber Cyan. JetBrains Mono for the manifesto text.
components.experience: Retro-Futurism timeline. Technical look. Scanlines or terminal-inspired UI for roles (Data Analyst Intern, AI Researcher, SE Intern). Vertical line glowing cyan to connect roles.
components.projects: The Tracing Beam (Aceternity Look) on project cards. Emphasize impact metrics ($90K retained revenue, $300K margin leakage, $94K recovery) with massive typography (text-5xl) in Cyan.
components.skills: Bento Grid. High-density, techy borders. Separate clusters: Python, SQL, ML/AI, Data Engineering, BI tools. Icons from Phosphor Icons.
components.marquee: One slow editorial marquee moving across the screen: 'DATA DRIVEN // AI FOCUSED // PROBLEM SOLVER'. Font: Unbounded Outline.
components.contact: Minimalist grid displaying Email, Phone, LinkedIn, GitHub. Solid Background with a hard top border. Huge 'LET'S BUILD' or 'CONTACT' text. No photo.

libraries: lenis (MANDATORY for premium smooth momentum scrolling)
react-tsparticles (for subtle glowing dots/grid lines in the background)
interactions: Hover states must trigger micro-animations (scale, border-glow).
Staggered entrance animations for timeline and bento grids.
Parallax/3D hero moment: Elements move slightly based on scroll depth.
rules: Motion should feel deliberate, premium, and mechanical, not bouncy or chaotic.

image_urls.description: Flowing blue abstract lines representing data streams. Use with low opacity (10-20%) and blend-mode: screen.
High-tech matrix display with glowing digital symbols. Good for AI/ML project card backgrounds or hover states.
Abstract glowing cyan rectangles. Use as an overlay or subtle background texture behind the experience timeline.

accessibility: Check contrast for Cyan text on dark backgrounds. Minimum 4.5:1.
Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative animations.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for heavy particle animations.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
